cs.t: For what it's worth I used a Clevo (branded as Medion) laptop as my daily driver for about 6 years, while backpacking around the world. The thing was a tank and still works as my backup at about 9 years old now. It's been through rainforests and deserts and up mountains and definitely got damp in a few rainstorms. Some keys on the keyboard no longer work and the bearings on the fan are very worn out. But that thing is a tank.
